title: S2 consumer authorization signal (envelope)
description: Signal 2 as carried in the package: the session (Tier 1) authorization and any step-up authorizations (Tier 2 INITIATE, Tier 3 EXECUTE), each with the certificate of the tier key that signed it; the scope expansion token, if the consumer expanded scope (§9.2); and the IVC-confirmed Servicing Intent Package for INITIATE and EXECUTE (§5.8). Verified by VAL-07, VAL-08 and VAL-08a (§6.2). Reference proposal: AFSP v0.1 leaves this format to the Technical Working Group (§18); this schema documents the reference implementation's proposal and is not normative AFSP.
